import uvicorn
from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from fastapi.security import HTTPBearer, HTTPAuthorizationCredentials
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from typing import List

from app.database import get_db, seed_database, User, Product, Review
from app.auth import hash_password, verify_password, create_access_token, verify_access_token
from app.schemas import (
    UserAuth, UserOut, Token, ProductOut,
    ReviewCreate, ReviewOut, ProductDetailOut, ModerationAction
)
from app.cache import cache_instance

app = FastAPI(
    title="Stage 2 Academic Ecommerce API",
    description="English-only backend service for the academic e-commerce demonstration with reviews & moderation.",
    version="2.0.0"
)

# Configure CORS explicitly to allow the frontend dev server on port 5173
app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=[
        "http://localhost:5173",
        "http://127.0.0.1:5173",
    ],
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)

security = HTTPBearer()

def get_current_user(credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Depends(security)) -> str:
    token = credentials.credentials
    user_id = verify_access_token(token)
    if not user_id:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
            detail="Session has expired or is invalid. Please sign in again.",
        )
    return user_id

@app.on_event("startup")
def on_startup():
    # Automatically create tables and seed demo product catalog
    seed_database()

@app.get("/health", status_code=status.HTTP_200_OK)
def health_check():
    """Health-check route to verify backend status."""
    return {"status": "healthy"}

@app.get("/api/products", response_model=List[ProductOut])
def get_products(db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    """Fetch the product catalog list."""
    cache_key = "products_list"
    cached = cache_instance.get(cache_key)
    if cached is not None:
        return cached

    products = db.query(Product).all()
    # Serialize to dictionary using schemas to avoid detached session issues when caching
    result = [ProductOut.model_validate(p).model_dump() for p in products]
    cache_instance.set(cache_key, result, ttl_seconds=60)
    return result

@app.get("/api/products/{id}", response_model=ProductDetailOut)
def get_product_detail(id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    """Fetch details of a single product with average rating."""
    cache_key = f"product_detail_{id}"
    cached = cache_instance.get(cache_key)
    if cached is not None:
        return cached

    product = db.query(Product).filter(Product.id == id).first()
    if not product:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail="Product not found."
        )
    # Calculate average rating
    approved_reviews = db.query(Review).filter(Review.product_id == id, Review.status == "approved").all()
    avg_rating = None
    if approved_reviews:
        avg_rating = sum(r.rating for r in approved_reviews) / len(approved_reviews)
        avg_rating = round(avg_rating, 2)
    
    result = {
        "id": product.id,
        "name": product.name,
        "image_url": product.image_url,
        "description": product.description,
        "price": product.price,
        "is_available": product.is_available,
        "average_rating": avg_rating
    }
    cache_instance.set(cache_key, result, ttl_seconds=60)
    return result

@app.get("/api/products/{id}/reviews", response_model=List[ReviewOut])
def get_product_reviews(id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    """Fetch approved reviews for a product."""
    cache_key = f"product_reviews_{id}"
    cached = cache_instance.get(cache_key)
    if cached is not None:
        return cached

    product = db.query(Product).filter(Product.id == id).first()
    if not product:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail="Product not found."
        )
    reviews = db.query(Review).filter(Review.product_id == id, Review.status == "approved").order_by(Review.created_at.desc()).all()
    result = [ReviewOut.model_validate(r).model_dump() for r in reviews]
    cache_instance.set(cache_key, result, ttl_seconds=60)
    return result

@app.post("/api/products/{id}/reviews", response_model=ReviewOut, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
def submit_review(
    id: int,
    review_data: ReviewCreate,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    current_user: str = Depends(get_current_user)
):
    """Submit a new product review (requires authentication)."""
    product = db.query(Product).filter(Product.id == id).first()
    if not product:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail="Product not found."
        )
    
    # Create the review
    new_review = Review(
        product_id=id,
        user_id=current_user,
        rating=review_data.rating,
        comment=review_data.comment,
        image_data=review_data.image_data,
        status="pending"
    )
    db.add(new_review)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(new_review)
    return new_review

@app.get("/api/moderation/reviews", response_model=List[ReviewOut])
def list_pending_reviews(
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    current_user: str = Depends(get_current_user)
):
    """List all pending reviews (moderator only)."""
    if current_user != "moderator":
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
            detail="Access denied. Only the moderator can access this resource."
        )
    pending_reviews = db.query(Review).filter(Review.status == "pending").order_by(Review.created_at.desc()).all()
    return pending_reviews

@app.post("/api/moderation/reviews/{review_id}/action", response_model=ReviewOut)
def moderate_review(
    review_id: int,
    action_data: ModerationAction,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    current_user: str = Depends(get_current_user)
):
    """Approve or reject a review (moderator only)."""
    if current_user != "moderator":
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
            detail="Access denied. Only the moderator can moderate reviews."
        )
    
    review = db.query(Review).filter(Review.id == review_id).first()
    if not review:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail="Review not found."
        )
    
    action = action_data.action.lower().strip()
    if action == "approve":
        review.status = "approved"
    elif action == "reject":
        review.status = "rejected"
    else:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            detail="Invalid action. Must be 'approve' or 'reject'."
        )
    
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(review)

    # Invalidate cache for product detail, reviews list, and the overall catalog list
    cache_instance.invalidate_key("products_list")
    cache_instance.invalidate_key(f"product_detail_{review.product_id}")
    cache_instance.invalidate_key(f"product_reviews_{review.product_id}")

    return review

@app.post("/api/auth/register", response_model=UserOut, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
def register(user_data: UserAuth, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    """Register a new user account."""
    # Ensure inputs are not empty or purely whitespaces
    id_stripped = user_data.account_identifier.strip()
    pw_stripped = user_data.password.strip()

    if not id_stripped or not pw_stripped:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            detail="Account identifier and password are required and cannot be empty."
        )

    # Check duplicate account identifier
    existing_user = db.query(User).filter(User.account_identifier == id_stripped).first()
    if existing_user:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            detail="Account identifier is already in use. Please select a unique identifier."
        )

    # Hash the password and save
    hashed_pw = hash_password(user_data.password)
    new_user = User(account_identifier=id_stripped, password_hash=hashed_pw)
    db.add(new_user)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(new_user)
    return new_user

@app.post("/api/auth/login", response_model=Token)
def login(user_data: UserAuth, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    """Login a user and return a session token."""
    id_stripped = user_data.account_identifier.strip()
    pw_stripped = user_data.password.strip()

    if not id_stripped or not pw_stripped:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            detail="Account identifier and password are required."
        )

    # Fetch user from DB
    user = db.query(User).filter(User.account_identifier == id_stripped).first()
    if not user or not verify_password(user_data.password, user.password_hash):
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
            detail="Invalid account identifier or password. Please verify your credentials."
        )

    # Create session token
    token = create_access_token(account_identifier=user.account_identifier)
    return Token(access_token=token, account_identifier=user.account_identifier)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    uvicorn.run("app.main:app", host="0.0.0.0", port=8000, reload=True)

# Start-Stage4.ps1
# Start RabbitMQ, 4 backend services, and frontend
Write-Host "Starting Stage 4 microservices stack..."
$Runtime = Get-Content -Raw -Path "stage4-runtime.json" | ConvertFrom-Json
$env:AMQP_URL = $Runtime.amqp_url
$env:EVENT_NAMESPACE = $Runtime.event_namespace
$env:VITE_API_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:$($Runtime.gateway_port)"

# Ensure any previous instance is stopped
if (Test-Path "stage4-pids.json") {
    Write-Host "Teardown previous processes..."
    & .\Stop-Stage4.ps1
}

Write-Host "Starting Identity Service on port $($Runtime.identity_port)..."
$IdentityProc = Start-Process python -ArgumentList "app/identity/main.py" -WorkingDirectory "backend" -NoNewWindow -PassThru

Write-Host "Starting Commerce Service on port $($Runtime.commerce_port)..."
$CommerceProc = Start-Process python -ArgumentList "app/commerce/main.py" -WorkingDirectory "backend" -NoNewWindow -PassThru

Write-Host "Starting Reviews Service on port $($Runtime.reviews_port)..."
$ReviewsProc = Start-Process python -ArgumentList "app/reviews/main.py" -WorkingDirectory "backend" -NoNewWindow -PassThru

# Give microservices a brief moment to bind to ports before starting gateway
Start-Sleep -Seconds 2

Write-Host "Starting API Gateway on port $($Runtime.gateway_port)..."
$GatewayProc = Start-Process python -ArgumentList "app/gateway/main.py" -WorkingDirectory "backend" -NoNewWindow -PassThru

Write-Host "Starting Frontend on port $($Runtime.frontend_port)..."
$FrontendProc = Start-Process npm -ArgumentList "run dev -- --port $($Runtime.frontend_port)" -WorkingDirectory "frontend" -NoNewWindow -PassThru

# Write PIDs to a file for clean teardown
$Pids = [PSCustomObject]@{
    Identity = $IdentityProc.Id
    Commerce = $CommerceProc.Id
    Reviews  = $ReviewsProc.Id
    Gateway  = $GatewayProc.Id
    Frontend = $FrontendProc.Id
}
$Pids | ConvertTo-Json | Out-File -FilePath "stage4-pids.json" -Force

# Wait for health check readiness
Write-Host "Waiting for services to become healthy..."
$Healthy = $false
for ($i = 0; $i -lt 10; $i++) {
    try {
        $Res = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:$($Runtime.gateway_port)/health" -TimeoutSec 1
        if ($Res.status -eq "healthy" -and $Res.services.identity.status -eq "healthy" -and $Res.services.commerce.status -eq "healthy" -and $Res.services.reviews.status -eq "healthy") {
            $Healthy = $true
            break
        }
    } catch {
        # ignore
    }
    Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
}

if ($Healthy) {
    Write-Host "All processes started successfully and verified healthy!"
    Write-Host "Access application at http://127.0.0.1:$($Runtime.frontend_port)"
} else {
    Write-Warning "Some services failed readiness check. Check your RabbitMQ status and logs."
}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# start-stage4.sh
# Start RabbitMQ, 4 backend services, and frontend in Linux/macOS
echo "Starting Stage 4 microservices stack..."
PORT_GATEWAY=18000
PORT_IDENTITY=18001
PORT_COMMERCE=18002
PORT_REVIEWS=18003
PORT_FRONTEND=18100

export AMQP_URL="amqp://ecommerce:stage4-demo@127.0.0.1:5672/stage4_openspec"
export EVENT_NAMESPACE="stage4.openspec"
export VITE_API_URL="http://127.0.0.1:18000"

python3 -m app.identity.main > identity.log 2>&1 &
echo $! > .pid_identity

python3 -m app.commerce.main > commerce.log 2>&1 &
echo $! > .pid_commerce

python3 -m app.reviews.main > reviews.log 2>&1 &
echo $! > .pid_reviews

sleep 2

python3 -m app.gateway.main > gateway.log 2>&1 &
echo $! > .pid_gateway

cd frontend
npm run dev -- --port 18100 > ../frontend.log 2>&1 &
echo $! > ../.pid_frontend
cd ..

echo "All processes started in the background."

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# stop-stage4.sh
# Teardown Stage 4 microservices stack in Linux/macOS
echo "Stopping Stage 4 microservices stack..."
for file in .pid_*; do
    if [ -f "$file" ]; then
        pid=$(cat "$file")
        echo "Stopping process $pid..."
        kill -9 "$pid" 2>/dev/null
        rm "$file"
    fi
done
echo "Teardown complete."

# Stage 1: Build stage
FROM python:3.11-slim AS builder

WORKDIR /build

# Set environment variables to optimize python
ENV PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 \
    PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1

RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

COPY requirements.txt .

# Install dependencies into a virtualenv
RUN python -m venv /opt/venv
ENV PATH="/opt/venv/bin:$PATH"
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt

# Stage 2: Final runtime stage
FROM python:3.11-slim AS runner

WORKDIR /app

# Set environment variables
ENV PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 \
    PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 \
    PATH="/opt/venv/bin:$PATH"

# Create non-root user
RUN groupadd -g 10001 appgroup && \
    useradd -u 10001 -g appgroup -m -s /bin/bash appuser

# Set working directory ownership to appuser
RUN chown appuser:appgroup /app

# Copy virtualenv from builder
COPY --from=builder /opt/venv /opt/venv

# Copy application source
COPY --chown=appuser:appgroup app/ app/

# Switch to non-root user
USER appuser

# Expose backend port
EXPOSE 8005

# Run backend application
CMD ["uvicorn", "app.main:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8005"]

version: '3.8'

services:
  rabbitmq:
    image: rabbitmq:3-management-alpine
    container_name: stage4-rabbitmq
    ports:
      - "5672:5672"
      - "15672:15672"
    environment:
      - RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_USER=ecommerce
      - RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_PASS=stage4-demo
      - RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_VHOST=stage4_openspec
    networks:
      - stage4-network

  identity:
    build:
      context: ./backend
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    container_name: stage4-identity
    ports:
      - "18001:18001"
    command: ["uvicorn", "app.identity.main:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "18001"]
    environment:
      - PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
    networks:
      - stage4-network

  commerce:
    build:
      context: ./backend
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    container_name: stage4-commerce
    ports:
      - "18002:18002"
    command: ["uvicorn", "app.commerce.main:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "18002"]
    environment:
      - PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
      - AMQP_URL=amqp://ecommerce:stage4-demo@rabbitmq:5672/stage4_openspec
      - EVENT_NAMESPACE=stage4.openspec
    depends_on:
      - rabbitmq
    networks:
      - stage4-network

  reviews:
    build:
      context: ./backend
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    container_name: stage4-reviews
    ports:
      - "18003:18003"
    command: ["uvicorn", "app.reviews.main:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "18003"]
    environment:
      - PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
      - AMQP_URL=amqp://ecommerce:stage4-demo@rabbitmq:5672/stage4_openspec
      - EVENT_NAMESPACE=stage4.openspec
    depends_on:
      - rabbitmq
    networks:
      - stage4-network

  gateway:
    build:
      context: ./backend
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    container_name: stage4-gateway
    ports:
      - "18000:18000"
    command: ["uvicorn", "app.gateway.main:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "18000"]
    environment:
      - PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
    depends_on:
      - identity
      - commerce
      - reviews
    networks:
      - stage4-network

  frontend:
    build:
      context: ./frontend
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
      args:
        - VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:18000
    container_name: stage4-frontend
    ports:
      - "18100:80"
    depends_on:
      - gateway
    networks:
      - stage4-network

networks:
  stage4-network:
    driver: bridge

import os
import json
import uuid
import time
import unittest
from datetime import datetime
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
import pika

# Import microservice models, bases, and apps
from app.identity.main import app as identity_app, Base as IdentityBase, User as IdentityUser, SessionLocal as IdentitySessionLocal
from app.commerce.main import app as commerce_app, Base as CommerceBase, Product as CommerceProduct, PublicReview, ProcessedEvent, SessionLocal as CommerceSessionLocal
from app.reviews.main import app as reviews_app, Base as ReviewsBase, Review as ReviewsReview, Outbox, SessionLocal as ReviewsSessionLocal
from app.gateway.main import app as gateway_app

from app.cache import cache_instance

# RabbitMQ runtime info
AMQP_URL = "amqp://ecommerce:stage4-demo@127.0.0.1:5672/stage4_openspec"
EVENT_NAMESPACE = "stage4.openspec"

class TestStage4DistributedArchitecture(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        # Set up clean database files for testing
        for db_file in ["identity.db", "commerce.db", "reviews.db"]:
            if os.path.exists(db_file):
                try:
                    os.remove(db_file)
                except Exception:
                    pass

        # Create tables in all databases
        IdentityBase.metadata.create_all(bind=create_engine("sqlite:///./identity.db"))
        CommerceBase.metadata.create_all(bind=create_engine("sqlite:///./commerce.db"))
        ReviewsBase.metadata.create_all(bind=create_engine("sqlite:///./reviews.db"))

        # Seed test product in Commerce DB
        db_comm = CommerceSessionLocal()
        if db_comm.query(CommerceProduct).filter(CommerceProduct.id == 1).count() == 0:
            test_product = CommerceProduct(
                id=1,
                name="Classic Ceramic Mug",
                image_url="http://example.com/mug.jpg",
                description="A high-quality ceramic mug.",
                price=12.99,
                is_available=True
            )
            db_comm.add(test_product)
            db_comm.commit()
        db_comm.close()

        cls.client_id = TestClient(identity_app)
        cls.client_comm = TestClient(commerce_app)
        cls.client_rev = TestClient(reviews_app)
        cls.client_gw = TestClient(gateway_app)

    def setUp(self):
        cache_instance.clear()

    def tearDown(self):
        cache_instance.clear()

    def test_auth_and_user_flows(self):
        # Test Registration
        reg_payload = {
            "account_identifier": f"testuser_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:6]}",
            "password": "securepassword"
        }
        response = self.client_id.post("/api/auth/register", json=reg_payload)
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 201)
        self.assertEqual(response.json()["account_identifier"], reg_payload["account_identifier"])

        # Test Login
        login_response = self.client_id.post("/api/auth/login", json=reg_payload)
        self.assertEqual(login_response.status_code, 200)
        self.assertIn("access_token", login_response.json())

    def test_reviews_submission_and_outbox_transactional_integrity(self):
        # 1. Register a user
        username = f"customer_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:6]}"
        self.client_id.post("/api/auth/register", json={"account_identifier": username, "password": "password"})
        login_res = self.client_id.post("/api/auth/login", json={"account_identifier": username, "password": "password"})
        token = login_res.json()["access_token"]
        headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}

        # 2. Submit a review via Reviews service (port 18003/router)
        review_payload = {
            "rating": 5,
            "comment": "Outstanding quality product!",
            "image_data": None
        }
        res_submit = self.client_rev.post("/api/products/1/reviews", headers=headers, json=review_payload)
        self.assertEqual(res_submit.status_code, 201)
        rev_id = res_submit.json()["id"]
        self.assertEqual(res_submit.json()["status"], "pending")

        # 3. Create Moderator Authorization Headers
        self.client_id.post("/api/auth/register", json={"account_identifier": "moderator", "password": "modpassword"})
        mod_login = self.client_id.post("/api/auth/login", json={"account_identifier": "moderator", "password": "modpassword"})
        mod_token = mod_login.json()["access_token"]
        mod_headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {mod_token}"}

        # 4. Moderate Review (Approve)
        res_mod = self.client_rev.post(f"/api/moderation/reviews/{rev_id}/action", headers=mod_headers, json={"action": "approve"})
        self.assertEqual(res_mod.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(res_mod.json()["status"], "approved")

        # Verify Transactional Outbox write
        db_rev = ReviewsSessionLocal()
        outbox_entries = db_rev.query(Outbox).filter(Outbox.status == "pending").all()
        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(outbox_entries), 1)
        
        target_entry = None
        for entry in outbox_entries:
            payload = json.loads(entry.payload)
            if payload.get("review_id") == rev_id:
                target_entry = entry
                break
        
        self.assertIsNotNone(target_entry)
        self.assertEqual(target_entry.event_type, "review_moderated")
        db_rev.close()

    def test_consumer_idempotency_and_duplicate_delivery(self):
        # 1. Manually insert a mock event and process it twice to test consumer idempotency
        event_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
        correlation_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
        payload = {
            "review_id": 999,
            "product_id": 1,
            "user_id": "test_idempotent_user",
            "rating": 5,
            "comment": "Idempotency comment",
            "image_data": None,
            "status": "approved"
        }

        # Create the mock event body as consumer receives it
        message = {
            "event_id": event_id,
            "correlation_id": correlation_id,
            "event_type": "review_moderated",
            "timestamp": datetime.utcnow().isoformat() + "Z",
            "payload": payload
        }

        # Execute processing via SessionLocal directly to test database state change and deduplication
        db_comm = CommerceSessionLocal()
        
        # Helper processing logic mirroring consumer
        def process_message(msg):
            evt_id = msg["event_id"]
            pld = msg["payload"]
            rev_id = pld["review_id"]
            prod_id = pld["product_id"]
            status_str = pld["status"]

            existing_evt = db_comm.query(ProcessedEvent).filter(ProcessedEvent.event_id == evt_id).first()
            if existing_evt:
                return "skipped"

            if status_str == "approved":
                new_proj = PublicReview(
                    id=rev_id,
                    product_id=prod_id,
                    user_id=pld["user_id"],
                    rating=pld["rating"],
                    comment=pld["comment"],
                    image_data=pld["image_data"],
                    status=status_str,
                    created_at=datetime.utcnow()
                )
                db_comm.add(new_proj)
            
            proc_evt = ProcessedEvent(event_id=evt_id)
            db_comm.add(proc_evt)
            db_comm.commit()
            return "processed"

        # First process
        status1 = process_message(message)
        self.assertEqual(status1, "processed")

        # Second process (should skip and not duplicate or crash)
        status2 = process_message(message)
        self.assertEqual(status2, "skipped")

        # Verify exactly one record exists in projection
        proj_count = db_comm.query(PublicReview).filter(PublicReview.id == 999).count()
        self.assertEqual(proj_count, 1)
        db_comm.close()

    def test_outage_and_recovery_flow(self):
        # Verify SQLite outbox holds onto events while we simulate RabbitMQ broker outage
        db_rev = ReviewsSessionLocal()
        event_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
        correlation_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
        payload = {
            "review_id": 888,
            "product_id": 1,
            "user_id": "outage_user",
            "rating": 3,
            "comment": "Offline comment",
            "image_data": None,
            "status": "approved"
        }

        outbox_entry = Outbox(
            event_id=event_id,
            correlation_id=correlation_id,
            event_type="review_moderated",
            payload=json.dumps(payload),
            status="pending"
        )
        db_rev.add(outbox_entry)
        db_rev.commit()

        # Check that the outbox is indeed persisting the event (not lost)
        entry_db = db_rev.query(Outbox).filter(Outbox.event_id == event_id).first()
        self.assertIsNotNone(entry_db)
        self.assertEqual(entry_db.status, "pending")
        db_rev.close()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import unittest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker

# Set a different database for testing or just use a local memory/file DB
# To avoid messing up the main db, we can mock get_db
import os
os.environ["DATABASE_URL"] = "sqlite:///./test_ecommerce.db"

from app.main import app
from app.database import Base, get_db, Product

# Setup a clean test database
SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URL = "sqlite:///./test_ecommerce.db"
engine = create_engine(SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URL, connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
TestingSessionLocal = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine)

def override_get_db():
    try:
        db = TestingSessionLocal()
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db

class TestReviewsWorkflow(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        # Remove old test DB if it exists
        if os.path.exists("test_ecommerce.db"):
            try:
                os.remove("test_ecommerce.db")
            except Exception:
                pass

        # Create tables and seed test product
        Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
        cls.db = TestingSessionLocal()
        # Seed a test product
        cls.test_product = Product(
            id=1,
            name="Test Coffee Cup",
            image_url="http://example.com/cup.jpg",
            description="Perfect for testing reviews.",
            price=9.99,
            is_available=True
        )
        cls.db.add(cls.test_product)
        cls.db.commit()
        cls.client = TestClient(app)

    @classmethod
    def tearDownClass(cls):
        cls.db.close()
        # Dispose of engine to release any open connections
        engine.dispose()
        # Clean up database file if possible, ignoring errors on Windows
        if os.path.exists("test_ecommerce.db"):
            try:
                os.remove("test_ecommerce.db")
            except Exception:
                pass

    def setUp(self):
        from app.cache import cache_instance
        cache_instance.clear()
        
        # Drop and recreate tables to ensure total isolation
        Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
        Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
        
        # Seed test product
        db = TestingSessionLocal()
        test_product = Product(
            id=1,
            name="Test Coffee Cup",
            image_url="http://example.com/cup.jpg",
            description="Perfect for testing reviews.",
            price=9.99,
            is_available=True
        )
        db.add(test_product)
        db.commit()
        db.close()

    def tearDown(self):
        from app.cache import cache_instance
        cache_instance.clear()

    def test_complete_reviews_and_moderation_flow(self):
        # 1. Fetch product detail, verify average_rating is None initially
        response = self.client.get("/api/products/1")
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        data = response.json()
        self.assertEqual(data["name"], "Test Coffee Cup")
        self.assertIsNone(data["average_rating"])

        # 2. Try to submit review without auth (should fail)
        response = self.client.post("/api/products/1/reviews", json={
            "rating": 5,
            "comment": "Unauthenticated review comment"
        })
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 401)

        # 3. Register and login normal user
        response = self.client.post("/api/auth/register", json={
            "account_identifier": "testuser",
            "password": "testpassword"
        })
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 201)

        response = self.client.post("/api/auth/login", json={
            "account_identifier": "testuser",
            "password": "testpassword"
        })
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        user_token = response.json()["access_token"]
        user_headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {user_token}"}

        # 4. Register and login moderator
        response = self.client.post("/api/auth/register", json={
            "account_identifier": "moderator",
            "password": "modpassword"
        })
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 201)

        response = self.client.post("/api/auth/login", json={
            "account_identifier": "moderator",
            "password": "modpassword"
        })
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        mod_token = response.json()["access_token"]
        mod_headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {mod_token}"}

        # 5. Submit valid review (should succeed, start as pending)
        response = self.client.post("/api/products/1/reviews", headers=user_headers, json={
            "rating": 4,
            "comment": "Excellent mug! Loved it.",
            "image_data": "data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAQAAAC1HAwCAAAAC0lEQVR42mNkYAAAAAYAAjCB0C8AAAAASUVORK5CYII="
        })
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 201)
        review_data = response.json()
        self.assertEqual(review_data["rating"], 4)
        self.assertEqual(review_data["comment"], "Excellent mug! Loved it.")
        self.assertEqual(review_data["status"], "pending")
        review_id = review_data["id"]

        # 6. Verify product detail still shows average_rating as None (pending reviews are hidden)
        response = self.client.get("/api/products/1")
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        self.assertIsNone(response.json()["average_rating"])

        # 7. Verify product reviews page returns empty list of approved reviews
        response = self.client.get("/api/products/1/reviews")
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(len(response.json()), 0)

        # 8. Try to list reviews for moderation as normal user (should be forbidden)
        response = self.client.get("/api/moderation/reviews", headers=user_headers)
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 403)

        # 9. List reviews for moderation as moderator (should see our pending review)
        response = self.client.get("/api/moderation/reviews", headers=mod_headers)
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        pending_list = response.json()
        self.assertEqual(len(pending_list), 1)
        self.assertEqual(pending_list[0]["id"], review_id)

        # 10. Approve review as moderator
        response = self.client.post(f"/api/moderation/reviews/{review_id}/action", headers=mod_headers, json={
            "action": "approve"
        })
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(response.json()["status"], "approved")

        # 11. Verify product detail now shows average_rating as 4.0
        response = self.client.get("/api/products/1")
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(response.json()["average_rating"], 4.0)

        # 12. Verify product reviews page returns the approved review
        response = self.client.get("/api/products/1/reviews")
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        reviews_list = response.json()
        self.assertEqual(len(reviews_list), 1)
        self.assertEqual(reviews_list[0]["comment"], "Excellent mug! Loved it.")
        self.assertEqual(reviews_list[0]["user_id"], "testuser")

    def test_caching_and_invalidation_flow(self):
        from app.cache import cache_instance
        # Clear cache first
        cache_instance.clear()

        # Register users if not already registered (ignore 400 if they exist)
        self.client.post("/api/auth/register", json={
            "account_identifier": "testuser",
            "password": "testpassword"
        })
        self.client.post("/api/auth/register", json={
            "account_identifier": "moderator",
            "password": "modpassword"
        })

        # 1. Fetch product detail (will be cached)
        response = self.client.get("/api/products/1")
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        
        # Verify it exists in cache
        cached_product = cache_instance.get("product_detail_1")
        self.assertIsNotNone(cached_product)
        self.assertEqual(cached_product["id"], 1)

        # 2. Fetch product reviews (will be cached)
        response = self.client.get("/api/products/1/reviews")
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        
        # Verify it exists in cache
        cached_reviews = cache_instance.get("product_reviews_1")
        self.assertIsNotNone(cached_reviews)

        # 3. Manually put some dummy data in cache to check hit
        cache_instance.set("product_detail_1", {
            "id": 1,
            "name": "Cached Mug",
            "image_url": "http://example.com/cup.jpg",
            "description": "Perfect for testing reviews.",
            "price": 9.99,
            "is_available": True,
            "average_rating": 5.0
        })
        response = self.client.get("/api/products/1")
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(response.json()["name"], "Cached Mug") # Proves it hit the cache!

        # 4. Perform moderator action to approve/reject a review, which should invalidate the cache
        response = self.client.post("/api/auth/login", json={
            "account_identifier": "moderator",
            "password": "modpassword"
        })
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        mod_headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {response.json()['access_token']}"}

        # Login standard user to submit review
        response = self.client.post("/api/auth/login", json={
            "account_identifier": "testuser",
            "password": "testpassword"
        })
        user_headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {response.json()['access_token']}"}
        
        response = self.client.post("/api/products/1/reviews", headers=user_headers, json={
            "rating": 5,
            "comment": "Super caching test!"
        })
        new_rev_id = response.json()["id"]

        # Moderate it (approve)
        response = self.client.post(f"/api/moderation/reviews/{new_rev_id}/action", headers=mod_headers, json={
            "action": "approve"
        })
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)

        # Verify that cache is invalidated (should be None)
        self.assertIsNone(cache_instance.get("product_detail_1"))
        self.assertIsNone(cache_instance.get("product_reviews_1"))
        self.assertIsNone(cache_instance.get("products_list"))

        # Fetch product detail again (should get real from DB, name is back to "Test Coffee Cup")
        response = self.client.get("/api/products/1")
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(response.json()["name"], "Test Coffee Cup")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import os
import sys

import uvicorn
from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, Column, Integer, String
from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base, sessionmaker, Session

from app.auth import hash_password, verify_password, create_access_token
from app.schemas import UserAuth, UserOut, Token

DATABASE_URL = "sqlite:///./identity.db"

engine = create_engine(
    DATABASE_URL, connect_args={"check_same_thread": False}
)
SessionLocal = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine)
Base = declarative_base()

class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = "users"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    account_identifier = Column(String, unique=True, index=True, nullable=False)
    password_hash = Column(String, nullable=False)

def get_db():
    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app = FastAPI(
    title="Identity Microservice",
    description="Manages authentication and user accounts.",
    version="4.0.0"
)

app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=["*"],
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)

@app.on_event("startup")
def on_startup():
    Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        if db.query(User).filter(User.account_identifier == "moderator").count() == 0:
            moderator_user = User(
                account_identifier="moderator",
                password_hash=hash_password("modpassword")
            )
            db.add(moderator_user)
            db.commit()
            print("Moderator successfully seeded in identity database.")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error seeding identity database: {e}")
        db.rollback()
    finally:
        db.close()

@app.get("/health", status_code=status.HTTP_200_OK)
def health_check():
    return {"status": "healthy", "service": "identity"}

@app.post("/api/auth/register", response_model=UserOut, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
def register(user_data: UserAuth, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    id_stripped = user_data.account_identifier.strip()
    pw_stripped = user_data.password.strip()

    if not id_stripped or not pw_stripped:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            detail="Account identifier and password are required and cannot be empty."
        )

    existing_user = db.query(User).filter(User.account_identifier == id_stripped).first()
    if existing_user:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            detail="Account identifier is already in use. Please select a unique identifier."
        )

    hashed_pw = hash_password(user_data.password)
    new_user = User(account_identifier=id_stripped, password_hash=hashed_pw)
    db.add(new_user)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(new_user)
    return new_user

@app.post("/api/auth/login", response_model=Token)
def login(user_data: UserAuth, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    id_stripped = user_data.account_identifier.strip()
    pw_stripped = user_data.password.strip()

    if not id_stripped or not pw_stripped:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            detail="Account identifier and password are required."
        )

    user = db.query(User).filter(User.account_identifier == id_stripped).first()
    if not user or not verify_password(user_data.password, user.password_hash):
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
            detail="Invalid account identifier or password. Please verify your credentials."
        )

    token = create_access_token(account_identifier=user.account_identifier)
    return Token(access_token=token, account_identifier=user.account_identifier)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    uvicorn.run("app.identity.main:app", host="127.0.0.1", port=18001)

import pika

from app.schemas import ProductOut, ProductDetailOut, ReviewOut
from app.cache import cache_instance

class ProcessedEvent(Base):

def get_db():

# RabbitMQ configuration
AMQP_URL = os.environ.get("AMQP_URL", "amqp://ecommerce:stage4-demo@127.0.0.1:5672/stage4_openspec")

def seed_products(db: Session):

            )
        ]
        db.add_all(demo_products)
        db.commit()
        print("Demo products seeded in commerce database.")

def consume_review_events():
    """Background consumer that subscribes to reviews moderation events."""
    print("Events consumer thread started.")
    connection = None
    channel = None
    
    while True:
        try:
            if connection is None or connection.is_closed:
                print(f"Consumer connecting to RabbitMQ at {AMQP_URL}...")
                parameters = pika.URLParameters(AMQP_URL)
                connection = pika.BlockingConnection(parameters)
                channel = connection.channel()
                
                # Declare exchange and queue
                channel.exchange_declare(exchange=EVENT_NAMESPACE, exchange_type='fanout', durable=True)
                
                # Use a durable queue name so that even if offline, RabbitMQ queues events
                queue_name = "commerce_review_projection_queue"
                channel.queue_declare(queue=queue_name, durable=True)
                channel.queue_bind(exchange=EVENT_NAMESPACE, queue=queue_name)
                
                print("Connected to RabbitMQ and queue bound successfully.")

            def callback(ch, method, properties, body):
                try:
                    event_data = json.loads(body.decode('utf-8'))
                    event_id = event_data.get("event_id")
                    payload = event_data.get("payload", {})
                    
                    product_id = payload.get("product_id")
                    review_id = payload.get("review_id")
                    status_str = payload.get("status")

                    print(f"Received event {event_id}: review {review_id} for product {product_id} ({status_str})")
                    
                    db = SessionLocal()
                    try:
                        # Idempotency Check
                        existing_event = db.query(ProcessedEvent).filter(ProcessedEvent.event_id == event_id).first()
                        if existing_event:
                            print(f"Event {event_id} already processed. Skipping.")
                            ch.basic_ack(delivery_tag=method.delivery_tag)
                            return

                        # Process Event
                        if status_str == "approved":
                            # Create or update PublicReview projection
                            existing_review = db.query(PublicReview).filter(PublicReview.id == review_id).first()
                            if not existing_review:
                                # Convert ISO created_at string
                                created_at_dt = datetime.utcnow()
                                if event_data.get("timestamp"):
                                    try:
                                        created_at_dt = datetime.fromisoformat(event_data["timestamp"].replace("Z", "+00:00"))
                                    except Exception:
                                        pass
                                
                                new_review = PublicReview(
                                    id=review_id,
                                    product_id=product_id,
                                    user_id=payload.get("user_id"),
                                    rating=payload.get("rating"),
                                    comment=payload.get("comment"),
                                    image_data=payload.get("image_data"),
                                    status=status_str,
                                    created_at=created_at_dt
                                )
                                db.add(new_review)
                            else:
                                existing_review.status = status_str
                        elif status_str == "rejected":
                            # Remove from projection or update to rejected (we can just delete from public reviews)
                            db.query(PublicReview).filter(PublicReview.id == review_id).delete()

                        # Register processed event ID
                        proc_event = ProcessedEvent(event_id=event_id)
                        db.add(proc_event)
                        db.commit()
                        print(f"Event {event_id} processed successfully.")
                        
                        # Invalidate local caches
                        cache_instance.invalidate_key("products_list")
                        cache_instance.invalidate_key(f"product_detail_{product_id}")
                        cache_instance.invalidate_key(f"product_reviews_{product_id}")
                        print(f"Caches invalidated for product {product_id}")
                    except Exception as db_ex:
                        print(f"Database error while processing event {event_id}: {db_ex}")
                        db.rollback()
                        # Reject message and requeue so it is retried
                        ch.basic_nack(delivery_tag=method.delivery_tag, requeue=True)
                        return
                    finally:
                        db.close()
                    
                    # Manually acknowledge on successful process
                    ch.basic_ack(delivery_tag=method.delivery_tag)
                except Exception as cb_ex:
                    print(f"Callback processing error: {cb_ex}")
                    ch.basic_nack(delivery_tag=method.delivery_tag, requeue=True)

            channel.basic_consume(queue="commerce_review_projection_queue", on_message_callback=callback, auto_ack=False)
            print("Started consuming RabbitMQ events.")
            channel.start_consuming()
            
        except pika.exceptions.AMQPConnectionError:
            print("RabbitMQ connection lost/failed in consumer. Retrying in 5 seconds...")
            connection = None
            channel = None
            time.sleep(5.0)
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Unexpected error in events consumer: {e}. Retrying in 5 seconds...")
            connection = None
            channel = None
            time.sleep(5.0)

@app.on_event("startup")
def on_startup():
    Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        seed_products(db)

                channel.queue_declare(queue=queue_name, durable=True)
                channel.queue_bind(exchange=EVENT_NAMESPACE, queue=queue_name)
                
                print("Connected to RabbitMQ and queue bound successfully.")

            def callback(ch, method, properties, body):
                try:
                    event_data = json.loads(body.decode('utf-8'))
                    event_id = event_data.get("event_id")
                    payload = event_data.get("payload", {})
                    
                    product_id = payload.get("product_id")
                    review_id = payload.get("review_id")
                    status_str = payload.get("status")

                        existing_event = db.query(ProcessedEvent).filter(ProcessedEvent.event_id == event_id).first()

                            print(f"Event {event_id} already processed. Skipping.")
                            ch.basic_ack(delivery_tag=method.delivery_tag)
                            return

                        # Process Event

                            existing_review = db.query(PublicReview).filter(PublicReview.id == review_id).first()

                                if event_data.get("timestamp"):

                                    except Exception:
                                        pass
                                
                                new_review = PublicReview(

                                    product_id=product_id,
                                    user_id=payload.get("user_id"),
                                    rating=payload.get("rating"),
                                    comment=payload.get("comment"),
                                    image_data=payload.get("image_data"),
                                    status=status_str,
                                    created_at=created_at_dt
                                )
                                db.add(new_review)
                            else:
                                existing_review.status = status_str
                        elif status_str == "rejected":
                            # Remove from projection or update to rejected (we can just delete from public reviews)
                            db.query(PublicReview).filter(PublicReview.id == review_id).delete()

                        # Register processed event ID
                        proc_event = ProcessedEvent(event_id=event_id)
                        db.add(proc_event)
                        db.commit()
                        print(f"Event {event_id} processed successfully.")
                        
                        # Invalidate local caches
                        cache_instance.invalidate_key("products_list")
                        cache_instance.invalidate_key(f"product_detail_{product_id}")
                        cache_instance.invalidate_key(f"product_reviews_{product_id}")

                        db.rollback()
                        # Reject message and requeue so it is retried
                        ch.basic_nack(delivery_tag=method.delivery_tag, requeue=True)
                        return
                    finally:
                        db.close()
                    
                    # Manually acknowledge on successful process
                    ch.basic_ack(delivery_tag=method.delivery_tag)
                except Exception as cb_ex:

                    ch.basic_nack(delivery_tag=method.delivery_tag, requeue=True)

            channel.start_consuming()

            channel = None

    """Background worker that continuously polls the outbox and publishes to RabbitMQ."""
    print("Outbox publisher thread started.")
    connection = None
    channel = None
    
    while True:
        try:
            # Setup connection with backoff
            if connection is None or connection.is_closed:
                print(f"Connecting to RabbitMQ at {AMQP_URL}...")

                for event in pending_events:
                    payload_dict = json.loads(event.payload)
                    message = {

                        "correlation_id": event.correlation_id,
                        "event_type": event.event_type,
                        "timestamp": event.created_at.isoformat() + "Z",
                        "payload": payload_dict
                    }

                    try:

                            exchange=EVENT_NAMESPACE,
                            routing_key='',
                            body=json.dumps(message),
                            properties=pika.BasicProperties(
                                delivery_mode=2, # make message durable
                                content_type='application/json',
                                message_id=event.event_id
                            )
                        )
                        # Mark as published
                        event.status = "published"
                        db.commit()
                        print(f"Published event {event.event_id} successfully.")
                    except pika.exceptions.UnroutableError:
                        print(f"Event {event.event_id} was unroutable.")
                    except Exception as pub_ex:
                        print(f"Failed to publish event {event.event_id}: {pub_ex}")

    return status_report

        )

    body = await request.body()

    headers.pop("host", None)
    headers.pop("content-length", None)

            )

# Start-Stage4.ps1
# Start RabbitMQ, 4 backend services, and frontend
Write-Host "Starting Stage 4 microservices stack..."
$Runtime = Get-Content -Raw -Path "stage4-runtime.json" | ConvertFrom-Json
$env:AMQP_URL = $Runtime.amqp_url
$env:EVENT_NAMESPACE = $Runtime.event_namespace
$env:VITE_API_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:$($Runtime.gateway_port)"

# Ensure any previous instance is stopped
if (Test-Path "stage4-pids.json") {
    Write-Host "Teardown previous processes..."
    & .\Stop-Stage4.ps1
}

Write-Host "Starting Identity Service on port $($Runtime.identity_port)..."
$IdentityProc = Start-Process python -ArgumentList "app/identity/main.py" -WorkingDirectory "backend" -NoNewWindow -PassThru

Write-Host "Starting Commerce Service on port $($Runtime.commerce_port)..."
$CommerceProc = Start-Process python -ArgumentList "app/commerce/main.py" -WorkingDirectory "backend" -NoNewWindow -PassThru

Write-Host "Starting Reviews Service on port $($Runtime.reviews_port)..."
$ReviewsProc = Start-Process python -ArgumentList "app/reviews/main.py" -WorkingDirectory "backend" -NoNewWindow -PassThru

# Give microservices a brief moment to bind to ports before starting gateway
Start-Sleep -Seconds 2

Write-Host "Starting API Gateway on port $($Runtime.gateway_port)..."
$GatewayProc = Start-Process python -ArgumentList "app/gateway/main.py" -WorkingDirectory "backend" -NoNewWindow -PassThru

Write-Host "Starting Frontend on port $($Runtime.frontend_port)..."
$FrontendProc = Start-Process cmd -ArgumentList "/c npm run dev -- --port $($Runtime.frontend_port)" -WorkingDirectory "frontend" -NoNewWindow -PassThru

# Write PIDs to a file for clean teardown
$Pids = [PSCustomObject]@{
    Identity = $IdentityProc.Id
    Commerce = $CommerceProc.Id
    Reviews  = $ReviewsProc.Id
    Gateway  = $GatewayProc.Id
    Frontend = $FrontendProc.Id
}
$Pids | ConvertTo-Json | Out-File -FilePath "stage4-pids.json" -Force

# Wait for health check readiness
Write-Host "Waiting for services to become healthy..."
$Healthy = $false
for ($i = 0; $i -lt 15; $i++) {
    try {
        $Res = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:$($Runtime.gateway_port)/health" -TimeoutSec 1
        if ($Res.status -eq "healthy" -and $Res.services.identity.status -eq "healthy" -and $Res.services.commerce.status -eq "healthy" -and $Res.services.reviews.status -eq "healthy") {
            $Healthy = $true
            break
        }
    } catch {
        # ignore
    }
    Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
}

if ($Healthy) {
    Write-Host "All processes started successfully and verified healthy!"
    Write-Host "Access application at http://127.0.0.1:$($Runtime.frontend_port)"
} else {
    Write-Warning "Some services failed readiness check. Check your RabbitMQ status and logs."
}

thoughts.subject: Implementing Persistent Background Processes
thoughts.description: I've pinpointed the issue: child processes initiated by `Start-Process` within `Start-Stage4.ps1` are being terminated upon script exit, a known CI challenge leading to empty services. My current approach is to leverage the `is_background` parameter within `run_shell_command` to launch and maintain these processes persistently, allowing for log inspection via `read_background_output`. This offers a robust solution for keeping services alive across script executions.

thoughts.subject: Securing Long-Term Process Stability
thoughts.description: I've discovered a surprisingly effective method: by introducing an infinite sleep loop at the end of `Start-Stage4.ps1`, the parent process remains active, preventing the termination of child processes. This ensures all services, including microservices and the frontend dev server, continue running as intended. I'm considering a `Start-KeepAlive.ps1` script or integrating a sleep mechanism with a switch.

thoughts.subject: Investigating AMQP Handshake Timeouts
thoughts.description: I'm seeing logs indicating timeouts during AMQP handshakes for both the events consumer and the outbox worker, specifically when connecting to '127.0.0.1'. This is unexpected and I'm digging into the cause.

thoughts.subject: Probing WSL RabbitMQ Connection
thoughts.description: I'm exploring why AMQP handshakes are timing out. The RabbitMQ instance runs within WSL, and I suspect issues with localhost/127.0.0.1 port forwarding, or perhaps the vhost/credentials are the culprit. I'll test alternative connection strings and verify the vhost configuration.
